goal: Make approved vacation filter intents open complete clean SEO pages while preserving exact operational search state.

intent_model.literal_request: The pool filter on the north vacation page must show an approved page instead of a query parameter.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The established approved-page policy must work consistently for the full semantic filter family.
likely_rejections: Only north plus pool is hardcoded
The new URL is clean but not a real published page
Transactional searches lose dates or prices
The page is absent from the sitemap

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Repair the shared approved-intent resolver and verify parallel filter combinations.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: A one-off redirect for pool on north is insufficient.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The visitor sees the selected location and amenity as one stable search intent.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Browse the approved result set for that intent.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open a matching place or change a filter.

natural_destination: VII vacation filtering and /search/vacations approved pages.

facts.claim: The resolver currently requires exactly one accommodation type.
The exact north plus generic pool intent has no current approved publication record.

assumptions.claim: The pool feature index yields current live matching inventory.
assumptions.validation: Render the managed page and inspect its result computation through existing tests and local verification.

in_scope: a complete approved north with pool page
permanent redirect from the exact technical source URL
out_of_scope: automatic publication of every possible filter combination
invariants: Dates, guests, price and sort remain transactional
Unapproved combinations remain query-based and non-fabricated
Existing type-specific approved pages keep their current canonicals
Only separately approved language editions may redirect

requirements.statement: An approved location and semantic feature combination resolves to its clean page even without an accommodation type.
The north with pool intent has complete publication content and a stable ASCII URL.
Transactional and unapproved states are preserved without fabricated SEO redirects.
requirements.source: User request and existing search behavior

requirements.statement: The approved page is self canonical and discoverable in the managed sitemap family.

acceptance_checks.action: Let the server resolve the filter intent.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A permanent redirect reaches /search/vacations/north-with-pool and the page renders matching results with complete content.

acceptance_checks.setup: Select an already approved no-type feature combination.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The existing approved canonical is returned without a feature-specific code branch.

acceptance_checks.setup: Add dates, price or sort to an approved semantic filter.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The operational location route retains the full query state and does not redirect to the static page.

acceptance_checks.setup: Use a semantic combination that has no approved publication.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The URL remains query-based and no indexable page is invented.

acceptance_checks.setup: Read the managed page and search-pages sitemap inventory.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The page is indexable, self canonical, complete and included exactly once in the sitemap.

authorization_boundary: Local repair and verification are authorized. Public publication is not implied by this request.
